chunks: Nothing took me by surprise, but the people coming to me like the mane of the hyena,
They rushed upon me from every side, so much so that the two shoulders were crushed and the ends of my shoulder garment were torn, as they gathered around me like a herd of sheep.
When I took up the reins of government, one party broke their pledge, another turned disobedient, and a third acted wrongfully

as if they had not heard Allah (Exalted is He) saying: 'That abode in the Hereafter, We assign it for those who intend not to exult themselves in the earth, nor (to make) mischief therein; and the end is (best) for the pious ones.'

key_terms.رَبِيضَةِ الْغَنَمِ: the herd of sheep (metaphor for a dense gathering)
key_terms.عُرْفِ الضَّبَعِ: the mane of the hyena (metaphor for a dense, rushing crowd)
key_terms.عِطْفَايَ: the ends of my shoulder garment

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali describe the public's reaction to his caliphate in the Shaqshaqiya sermon?
ai.summary: In the Shaqshaqiya sermon, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) vividly depicts the chaotic scramble for power using the metaphor of a stampeding herd, highlighting the physical toll of assuming leadership amidst political turbulence. He contrasts the initial rush for authority with the subsequent fragmentation of his supporters into three distinct groups: those who broke their pledge, those who rebelled, and those who acted unjustly, linking their behavior to the Quranic promise that the Hereafter belongs to the righteous who avoid arrogance and corruption.

en.sayed-ali-raza: At that moment, nothing took me by surprise, but the crowd of people rushing to me. It advanced towards me from every side like the mane of the hyena
so much so that Ḥasan and Ḥusayn were getting crushed and both the ends of my shoulder garment were torn. They collected around me like the herd of sheep and goats.
When I took up the reins of government one party broke away and another turned disobedient while the rest began acting wrongfully

as if they had not heard the word of Allāh saying : “That abode in the hereafter, We assign it for those who intend not to exult themselves in the earth, nor (to make) mischief (therein) ; and the end is (best) for the pious ones.” (Qur’ān, 28:83)
